notes.title: 10th Anniversary of Notch Series and a New Title
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10863167/2274333ffa25b98b836e2bc057cb5c0772197a0d.jpg[/img]

March 2018 marks the 10th anniversary of the Notch series. We'd like to thank you all for the attention and support you’ve given to AngelsBlue.

We’d also like to take this opportunity to reveal a new project in the Notch series to you all. We are now developing Notch Zero, which has a brand new storyline. Apart from having a long story, multiple routes/endings, a new engine, and enhanced gameplay, there will also be more than 60 tracks in Notch Zero. We also intend to invite a famous singer to join the music production. As this will be a larger project, the work involved is expected to take a little longer. 

Here, we also hope that all of you will continue to support us. The past decade has not been easy for us, and we sincerely hope that the Notch series will continue on so we may have more opportunities to bring more impressive stories to everyone. Whether you are a new player or an old friend, or whether you prefer the Steam version or the physical version, your support greatly encourages us. We hope that you’ll continue to stay with us for the next decade.

For more information regarding the Notch series, please visit AngelsBlue's website (Chinese): https://angelsblue.org/

notes.title: Gun Wings Update 28th Jan, 2016
notes.notes:
A new patch for Gun Wings has been released. We have fixed several bugs/mistakes reported by the community. If you have any more questions, feel free to report it in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/348240/discussions/0/492379439690885596/]this thread[/url].

1. Added the "L" button. You can now either use Shift or the L button to move slowly.

2. Added a notice: "Press F11 to switch to fullscreen."

3. Slightly modified the controller's deadzone.

4. Added three new character designs in the statistics screen for each character.

5. Added a new ending to the game's story.

6. Fixed the issue of people still hearing the button tones when the game is minimized.

7. Fixed translation errors in the Russian and Japanese localizations.

8. Fixed the "Charge-Attack Genius" achievement not working properly in some situations.

9. Fixed a bug where the game would not run on certain versions of Windows.

10. Some other minor fixes.

Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Gun Wings - Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Our latest Shmup game, Gun Wings, is now available on Steam! For the first week, you can get it for 10% OFF.

Compared to the demo, which was announced earlier, this version is fully integrated with several Steam functions such as Steam Trading Cards, Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud, Steam Leaderboards, and Xbox controller support.

To report a bug, make a suggestion, or find more information, please head to this thread below:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/348240/discussions/0/492379439690885596/

To view the trading card and background designs, please click this link:

http://www.steamcardexchange.net/index.php?gamepage-appid-348240

This is our third title on Steam. We hope you will enjoy it.
